attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI 3.x; Mailchimp publishes Swagger 2.0

notes: Full coverage of the Mailchimp Marketing API v3.0.91, converted from Mailchimp's own Swagger 2.0 document committed verbatim as upstream.json — every one of the upstream's 308 operations survives the conversion (308 in, 308 out; the upstream declares no named definitions, so 0 schemas in and 0 out), across all 181 documented paths (lists/audiences, members, segments, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, e-commerce stores, batches, webhooks, file manager, landing pages, connected sites, verified domains). Replaces a 22 KiB hand-authored spec covering ~15 endpoints. CAVEAT on data-schemas: only the `?expand` form of the document is self-contained (the plain form $refs external URLs), and expanding inlines every schema at its use site, so the spec has no named components and therefore no data objects to extract. Coverage of the API surface is unaffected; the request/response shapes are all present inline. Refreshed 2026-11-16: the vendor document added 10 operations since the 2026-09-03 capture (the path count quoted above predates the refresh).
